scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -b packages/core packages/cli packages/mcp
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test "packages/core/dist/test/**/*.test.js" && node scripts/mcp-smoke.mjs && node scripts/benchmark.mjs && node scripts/robustness.mjs 80
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && node scripts/benchmark.mjs && node scripts/robustness.mjs 80
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['core','cli','mcp']) require('fs').rmSync('packages/'+p+'/dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
